## Activity

During December 2022, West Gate Eye Clinic recorded 366 captures. This is the activity total reported for the site for the month. The figure provides the basis for the subsequent image-quality and grading review.

The activity record relates to captures completed at West Gate Eye Clinic during December 2022. It is reported separately from the assessment of whether images could be graded and from the number of referable results identified.

## Image quality

Of the 366 captures, 20 were recorded as ungradable. The ungradable rate was 5.5. This result is presented alongside the monthly capture total to show the proportion of activity for which grading could not be completed.

## Grading

Grading identified 91 referable results. The median lag between capture and grading was 2.

The figures for activity, image quality and grading provide the operational summary for West Gate Eye Clinic for December 2022. The ungradable total and rate should be considered when reviewing the grading outcome, while the median lag records the central turnaround measure for the month.
